delay.description: Cool-down duration before update is considered available (e.g. 3d, 24h)

isCoolingDown.description: Whether the update is currently held in cool-down period

coolingDownUntil.description: Epoch timestamp (ms) until which the update is held in cool-down

isSnoozed.description: Whether the update for this container is currently snoozed

snoozedUntil.description: Epoch timestamp (ms) until which the update is snoozed

result.description:
What the registry currently offers for the watched container.

For a container watched by digest, `version` and `created` are read from the
remote image config once per remote digest, and only once an update has been
found - so they describe *what* changed, where the tag alone (typically
`latest`) says nothing.

tag.description: The tag WUD would update to.

digest.description: The remote manifest digest, when the container is watched by digest.

created.description:
Build date of the remote image, normalized to millisecond precision.
`image.created` is normalized the same way, so the two stay comparable.
For legacy schemaVersion 1 manifests this comes from the manifest itself
rather than the image config.

version.description:
The remote image's `org.opencontainers.image.version` label, when it
carries one. Images whose label is a floating value such as `latest` or
`nightly` report that value verbatim, so compare `created` against the
local `image.created` in that case.

link.description: Link to the image on the registry, when a link template is available.
